basic_info.description: Step into your dream home, just moments away from all of life's needs and pleasures! Inside this urban retreat, natural light pours in, filling the open space with a glow, offering stunning views of the city skyline. The design is sleek & modern, creating a perfect blend of comfort & sophistication. This home is a haven of relaxation & style and the building itself is a testament to luxury living with onsite management, maintenance and security. Unwind in the heated pool or spa, stay active in the state- of-the-art gym & enjoy social gatherings or movie nights in the club room & movie theater. An underground parking space is a practical touch, complete with the option to install an EV charger and one of the largest private storage rooms in the building! Beyond the home’s walls, San Francisco unfolds with convenience & charm. Public transportation is easily accessible from the nearby Ferry Building, Muni, Bart, CalTrain and Amtrak stations. Whether exploring the vibrant culinary scene, the new China Basin Park or enjoying a concert or game at Oracle or Chase Center, the city’s energy & excitement are always within reach. This is more than just a home—it’s a gateway to an enviable San Francisco lifestyle, blending luxury, convenience & excitement into one perfect package.
